articles.summary: MACAU, Sept. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Melco Resorts & Entertainment (NASDAQ: MLCO) announces that Morpheus at City of Dreams has been awarded Three MICHELIN Keys in the MICHELIN Guide’s 2026 global hotel selection, becoming the first hotel in Macau to receive the distinction.
articles.title: Melco’s Morpheus becomes Macau’s first hotel to receive Three MICHELIN Keys
